'''Jeff Field''' was a member of Dark Force Rising, a Star Wars CCG team with [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Jeff Davis]] and [[Dan Hammond]]. [[Torch Industries]] listed the team.<ref name="rising">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/rising.html Dark Force Rising], Paul Todd Feldman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022071037/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/rising.html Internet Archive]</ref>
